reuse.why: Guards live in link.ts next to findOrCreateBank and every provider calls them, and the Fintegra flow reuses findOrCreateBank/syncAccount/handleSyncResponse, but the takeover re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: ensureAccountNotLinked copies unlinkAccount's updateAccount reset verbatim, downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of the Enable Banking download, linkFintegraAccount repeats the upgrade-or-insert body of the other link handlers, and the ensureAccountIsOpen + ensureAccountNotLinked pair is pasted into six handlers.

placement.why: Link guards in accounts/link.ts, the download in sync.ts's provider dispatch, server URL in server-config and types under types/models follow the tree's layout.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (link uniqueness, Fintegra provider, closed-account rule, takeover flag).

maintainability.why: Rules are centralised in link.ts, but the unlink reset now has two copies that can drift and each handler must remember to call two guards in order.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts ensureAccountNotLinked re-implements the unlink reset in app.ts unlinkAccount instead of sharing it.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (unlink reset, Fintegra download and link body) are near-verbatim, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureAccountNotLinked, a guard, gains a replaceExistingLink flag and a branch that mutates the previous holder; all six link handlers call it.
